name: Jev Compute
description: The prompts JevAgent's mid-run compute checkpoint uses when FRESH_AGENT is selected. reset_prompt gives the fresh helper the user's request, verified run brief, exact run facts, and bounded recent numbered events so it can make independent progress. Its placeholders are {request}, {brief}, {facts}, and {recent}. reset_result carries the helper's report back to the main agent; its placeholder is {report}.
